result.content: Defence objects to the pending direct question. It assumes cash contents and knowing receipt; E-001 (fictional-mira.txt) states only that the envelope was sealed and that Mira "do[es] not know what the envelope contained." No knowing-participation element is supplied in the pinned packet, and no actual offence is defined. Neutral questions about Mira's observation remain permitted. We ask the Court to sustain the objection and strike the question only; E-001 is not sought to be excluded.
